title: Changelog · Fly.io
markdown:
Nov 9, 2026


## [Pocket money for agents](https://fly.io/changelog/link-agent-wallet/)

Connect Stripe's Link wallet to your Sprites. An agent asks for a one-time card for one purchase, and you approve it in the Link app.


![](https://sea1.discourse-cdn.com/fly1/user_avatar/community.fly.io/kyle/288/51406_2.png)
Kyle McLaren


Nov 4, 2026


## [Agents can now send us feedback](https://fly.io/changelog/agents-can-now-send-us-feedback/)

Agents can now report bugs, docs gaps and feature requests through the Fly API, tied to a request ID or a URL.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/straube/96/51225_2.png)
Gustavo


Nov 3, 2026


## [An Oban Odyssey](https://fly.io/changelog/an-oban-odyssey/)

A slow internal Oban dashboard led us to a chatty metrics plugin, a missing index and a 460 GB index that shrank to about 2 GB.


![](https://avatars.discourse-cdn.com/v4/letter/j/b2d939/96.png)
Jacob Fenton


## [Use Droid with Fly](https://fly.io/changelog/use-droid-with-fly/)

Fly MCP support, skills and a plugin for Factory's droid agent, installable with \`fly skills\` or \`fly setup agent\`.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/aezell_fly/96/43735_2.png)
Alex Ezell


Oct 30, 2026


## [Give your agent the fly CLI](https://fly.io/changelog/give-your-agent-the-fly-cli/)

flyctl gains \`fly skills\` and \`fly setup agent\`, which install Fly agent skills and configure the Fly MCP for your coding agent.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/aezell_fly/96/43735_2.png)
Alex Ezell


Oct 23, 2026


## [New Fly MCP](https://fly.io/changelog/new-fly-mcp/)

Earlier this year, with the launch of Sprites, we released the Sprites MCP. That has been very useful for people using agents to work with Fly. But, it was always missing the rest of Fly.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/aezell_fly/96/43735_2.png)
Alex Ezell


Oct 7, 2026


## [Rotate MPG user passwords from flyctl](https://fly.io/changelog/rotate-postgres-passwords-flyctl/)

Rotate Managed Postgres user passwords from flyctl with fly mpg users rotate-password.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/tripledoublev/96/50306_2.png)
Vincent Charlebois


Oct 1, 2026


## ['List' endpoints in Machines API now support pagination](https://fly.io/changelog/machines-api-pagination/)

The Machines API's list endpoints for Machines, volumes and apps now support pagination.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/nullhypothesis/96/47869_2.png)
Philipp Winter


Sep 22, 2026


## [`fly auth logout` is now less likely to bite you](https://fly.io/changelog/fly-auth-logout-fix/)

fly auth logout now only revokes your locally stored token, not FLY\_API\_TOKEN or FLY\_ACCESS\_TOKEN.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/nullhypothesis/96/47869_2.png)
Philipp Winter


Sep 15, 2026


## [Managed Postgres is now in the Machines API](https://fly.io/changelog/managed-postgres-machines-api/)

Create, fork, restore and delete Managed Postgres clusters through the Machines API.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/tripledoublev/96/50306_2.png)
Vincent Charlebois


Sep 2, 2026


## [Cutting Corrosion’s Broadcast Bandwidth by 10x](https://fly.io/changelog/corrosion-bandwidth-reduction/)

Corrosion, our state-replication system, now uses about a tenth of the bandwidth, thanks to compression and Plumtree.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/somt0xhi/96/42794_2.png)
Somtochi Onyekwere


Sep 1, 2026


## [Egress IP support in Machines API](https://fly.io/changelog/machines-api-egress-ips/)

Create and manage app-scoped egress IPs through the Machines API.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/lillian/96/49616_2.png)
Lillian Berry


Aug 13, 2026


## ["Where is my billing page?"; alternative title: making billing page easier to find](https://fly.io/changelog/find-billing-page/)

Billing is now linked from settings and the account menu, where people kept looking for it.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/lubien/96/41919_2.png)
Lubien


Aug 11, 2026


## [Tweaks and improvements for PaaS deployments in UI and CLI!](https://fly.io/changelog/bluegreen-deploy-improvements/)

Dashboard scale operations show up in activity, and bluegreen deploys in flyctl catch more misconfigurations.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/lubien/96/41919_2.png)
Lubien


## [You can now restore your MPGv1 backups as a v2 cluster](https://fly.io/changelog/managed-postgres-v1-backup-to-v2/)

Restore a Managed Postgres v1 backup into a new v2 cluster from the dashboard.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/akshit-fly/96/37188_2.png)
Akshit Garg


Aug 10, 2026


## [fly mpg restore now supports naming and point-in-time restore](https://fly.io/changelog/managed-postgres-point-in-time-restore/)

fly mpg restore can now restore to a point in time and name the restored cluster.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/tripledoublev/96/50306_2.png)
Vincent Charlebois


Aug 3, 2026


## [Small tweaks to repo-reattachment flow](https://fly.io/changelog/github-repo-reconnect/)

Reconnecting a GitHub repo to an app no longer triggers a new deploy, and finds fly.toml outside the repo root.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/lubien/96/41919_2.png)
Lubien


## [Fly Machines API connector for Sprites](https://fly.io/changelog/sprites-machines-api-connector/)

Connect Sprites to the Fly Machines API without putting a Fly token inside the Sprite.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/lubien/96/41919_2.png)
Lubien


## [Improvements to PaaS UI settings](https://fly.io/changelog/dashboard-app-settings/)

More per-app settings are editable in the dashboard, and changes open a PR against your fly.toml if you've connected GitHub.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/lubien/96/41919_2.png)
Lubien


Jul 30, 2026


## [Secrets batch import on UI!](https://fly.io/changelog/dashboard-secrets-bulk-import/)

Paste a whole .env file into the dashboard to import secrets in one go.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/lubien/96/41919_2.png)
Lubien


Jul 20, 2026


## [MPGv2: New Regions and GA](https://fly.io/changelog/managed-postgres-v2-ga/)

Managed Postgres v2 is in seven more regions and heading to GA. New v1 clusters will be turned off.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/juliana/96/42710_2.png)
Juliana de Oliveira


Jul 16, 2026


## [Machine details page now shows cordon and lease status](https://fly.io/changelog/machine-cordon-lease-status/)

The Machine details page now shows whether a Machine is cordoned or leased.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/nullhypothesis/96/47869_2.png)
Philipp Winter


## [MPGv2 has forking in beta](https://fly.io/changelog/managed-postgres-v2-forking/)

Fork a Managed Postgres v2 cluster from the dashboard, much faster than restoring a backup.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/akshit-fly/96/37188_2.png)
Akshit Garg


Jul 8, 2026


## [Sprites now run Ubuntu 26.04 LTS](https://fly.io/changelog/sprites-ubuntu-26-04/)

New Sprites now run Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.


![](https://community.fly.io/user_avatar/community.fly.io/jae/96/43881_2.png)
Jae Beller


Jul 3, 2026


## [A new home page for your MPG v2 clusters](https://fly.io/changelog/managed-postgres-v2-cluster-overview/)

A rebuilt overview page for Managed Postgres v2 clusters.


![](https://sea1.discourse-cdn.com/fly1/user_avatar/community.fly.io/kyle/288/51406_2.png)
Kyle McLaren
